# speak

> macOS-native, local-first voice dictation — speech → on-device AI
> neat-writing → pasted at cursor. Menubar app, macOS 26 (Tahoe), Apple
> Silicon M5/M4. MIT licensed, alpha stage.
>
> **This repository is agent-native.** Contributions are authored by agents
> and directed/reviewed by humans. AGENTS.md is the operating manual — read
> it before writing any code.

## Start here (agents, in order)

- `AGENTS.md` — operating manual: hard rules (§2), file authority (§3),
  session loading protocol (§4), verification gate (§7), commit rules (§8)
- `docs/progress.md` — current state; read at session start, update at end
- `docs/roadmap.md` — task queue; lowest-numbered dependency-ready item
- `docs/README.md` — docs index by task and audience

## Hard rules (a PR violating these fails — they are structural, not style)

- No network egress, telemetry, accounts, or third-party runtime deps in
  `SpeakCore` / `Speak` app / CLI targets — verified by `make verify-moat`
  (7/7 must pass). Cloud integrations live ONLY in `SpeakLLM.framework`.
- Never read the pasteboard — write-only (`PasteboardWriter`).
- Hardware mute blocks capture unconditionally.
- No `print` (use `os.Logger` / `SpeakLog`), no force-unwrap/`try!`/`as!`
  outside tests, no global mutable state, never block the main thread.
- Apple frameworks only. Swift 5.9+/SwiftUI. macOS 26.0 deployment. arm64.
- Tag API claims `[verified]`/`[inferred]`/`[decision]`/`[unverified]` —
  verify Apple APIs with `swiftc -typecheck` against the macOS 26 SDK.

## Verify your work (in order of speed)

- `make test-fast` — ~3s prompt/cleanup subset (inner dev loop)
- `make preflight` — the PR checks: moat + lint + compile (~2-3 min)
- `make gates` — merge gate: build + test + lint + verify-moat
- `make compat` — hardware/OS/toolchain check (M5/M4, macOS 26+)
- `xcodegen generate` after adding/removing `.swift` files (glob gotcha)

## Architecture map

- `Speak/App/` — SwiftUI shell (menubar, HUD overlay, dashboard, settings)
- `Speak/SpeakCore/` — headless engine: actors `SpeakEngine`/`CaptureSession`,
  protocol seams `Transcribing`/`LLMCleaning`/`TextInserting`/`HistoryStoring`
- `Speak/SpeakLLM/` — opt-in OpenAI-compatible cleanup (the only target with
  networking symbols; isolated so the moat audit stays honest)
- `Speak/Tests/SpeakTests/` — XCTest + Swift Testing; TEST_HOST = Speak.app
- `docs/architecture.md` — full module map; `docs/ui/philosophy.md` — UI why

## For humans (reading/observing, not authoring)

- `README.md` — product intro, install, comparison
- `docs/ui/philosophy.md` — why each surface exists
- `docs/progress.md` — observable work log (every session writes it)
- `docs/human-verification.md` — things only a human+real Mac can verify
